# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 R2 Latin Greece phases 1-4, the Navarrese and the Acciaioli 1379-1396, the West changes hands 1347-1375, the Ottomans and the Tocco 1385-1449, the late years 1383-1446 (oe_lgr_). Generated by gen_latin_greece.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 24); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, close; then the world steps, and at most one event in a calm,
# free month.
oe_lgr_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_on } } set_variable = oe_lgr_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1450.1.1 }
            set_variable = oe_lgr_off
            debug_log = "oe_lgr: the line is closed"
        }
        else = {
            # phase 2: the first month the line runs with phase 2 (a new game, or a save from before it) is marked, so
            # the steps that only change a ruler can be caught up once (design 3.2).
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p2 } } set_variable = oe_lgr_p2 set_variable = oe_lgr_p2_new }
            # phase 3: the same mark for the step of phase 3 that only changes a ruler (ep8).
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p3 } } set_variable = oe_lgr_p3 set_variable = oe_lgr_p3_new }
            # phase 4: the same mark for the steps of phase 4 that only change a ruler (la5, la7, la8).
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p4 } } set_variable = oe_lgr_p4 set_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new }
            oe_lgr_world = yes
            oe_lgr_events = yes
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p2_new } remove_variable = oe_lgr_p2_new }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p3_new } remove_variable = oe_lgr_p3_new }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new } remove_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new }
        }
    }
}

        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_m <= 1128 oe_lgr_ep13_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_ep13 oe_lgr_ep13_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep13 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 1128 }
            if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ep13_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_ep13 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_ep13 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_lgr world step ep13 missed (ws3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws3a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws3b')|0] chk [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk3a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk3b')|0] fall [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_fall')|0])"
        }
    }
    # ep14 Arta falls (months 1347-1356, 30% a month, sure in the last; result looked at again)
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 global_var:oe_lgr_chk_ep14 = 9 } oe_lgr_check_ep14 = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep14 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 1347 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_m <= 1356 oe_lgr_ep14_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_ep14 oe_lgr_ep14_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep14 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 1356 }
            if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ep14_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_ep14 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_ep14 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_lgr world step ep14 missed (ws3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws3a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws3b')|0] chk [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk3a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk3b')|0] fall [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_fall')|0])"
        }
    }
    # la5 The Crispo in Naxos (months 555-564, 20% a month, sure in the last; caught up once)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la5 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 555 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_m <= 564 oe_lgr_la5_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_la5 oe_lgr_la5_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la5 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 564 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new var:oe_lgr_m > 564 oe_lgr_la5_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la5_run = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_la5_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la5 value = 3 } debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la5 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la5 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la5 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
        }
    }
    # la6 Negroponte to Venice (months 637-648, 20% a month, sure in the last; result looked at again)
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_la6 global_var:oe_lgr_chk_la6 = 9 } oe_lgr_check_la6 = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la6 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 637 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_m <= 648 oe_lgr_la6_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_la6 oe_lgr_la6_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la6 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 648 }
            if = { limit = { oe_lgr_la6_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la6 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la6 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la6 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])"
        }
    }
    # la7 Achaea's new prince (months 709-720, 20% a month, sure in the last; caught up once)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 709 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_m <= 720 oe_lgr_la7_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_la7 oe_lgr_la7_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 720 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new var:oe_lgr_m > 720 oe_lgr_la7_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la7_run = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_la7_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la7 value = 3 } debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la7 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la7 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la7 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
        }
    }
    # la8 Zaccaria buys the title (months 805-816, 20% a month, sure in the last; caught up once)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 805 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_m <= 816 oe_lgr_la8_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_la8 oe_lgr_la8_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8 } var:oe_lgr_m >= 816 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new var:oe_lgr_m > 816 oe_lgr_la8_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la8_run = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_la8_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la8 value = 3 } debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la8 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la8 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la8 missed (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
        }
    }
    # phase 4: .20 a (Athens our client) and D4's oe_lat.12 (read only)
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ath20 global_var:oe_lgr_chk_ath20 = 9 } oe_lgr_check_ath20 = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_athens_client global_var:oe_lgr_athens_client = 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_hex_old } var:oe_lat_fired_12 ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_hex_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_hex_seen value = var:oe_lgr_m } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_lgr_since_hex >= 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_hex ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_athens_client value = 3 } }
            else = { oe_lgr_release_ath = yes }
            debug_log = "oe_lgr .20: the Hexamilion decided the tie with Athens (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])"
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events: lapse, then at most one in a calm month while the lock is free (design 3.3).
# (phase 2: .11 .12; phase 3: .13 .14; phase 4: .4 .20)
oe_lgr_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_12 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_13 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_14 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_14 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_lapse_20 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_20 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_12 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_12 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 12 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_13 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_13 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 13 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_14 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_14 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 14 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 0 oe_lgr_ok_20 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lgr_ch_20 set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pick value = 20 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_11 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 11 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.11 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_12 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.12 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 13 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_13 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 13 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.13 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 14 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_14 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 14 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.14 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_4 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.4 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_pick = 20 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_20 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_last value = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.20 }
        remove_variable = oe_lgr_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A world step runs: its effect, its record (global oe_lgr_ws_<s> = 1) and the month the event that
# follows it counts from.
oe_lgr_la1_run = {
    oe_lgr_la1_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la1 value = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la1 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lgr_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws')|0])"
}
oe_lgr_la2_run = {
    oe_lgr_la2_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la2 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_nav_m value = var:oe_lgr_m }
    debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la2 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lgr_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws')|0])"
}
oe_lgr_la3_run = {
    oe_lgr_la3_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la3 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ath_m value = var:oe_lgr_m }
    debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la3 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lgr_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws')|0])"
}
oe_lgr_la4_run = {
    oe_lgr_la4_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_la4 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_will_m value = var:oe_lgr_m }
    debug_log = "oe_lgr world step la4 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lgr_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws')|0])"
}

# BYZ scope. la1 Thebes sacked (1379: a band of the Navarrese Company storms Thebes): looted for 3 years, Livadeia
# too while it has the same owner; the owner loses prestige.
oe_lgr_la1_do = {
    location:thebes = {
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace }
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_th add_prestige = -10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:livadeia = { exists = owner owner = scope:oe_lgr_th } }
        location:livadeia = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_thebes value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. la2 the Company in Achaea (1381-1386): a modifier on Achaea, friendship with an AI Venice (the treaty of
# 1387), a feud with the lord of Athens. The prince and Naples's overlordship stay as they are (design, item 9).
oe_lgr_la2_do = {
    c:ACH = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_lgr_navarrese_rule years = 20 mode = replace } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_ai = yes } }
        c:ACH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_navarino target = c:VEN } }
        c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_navarino target = c:ACH } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_has_ath = yes }
        location:athens = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ath_s } }
        c:ACH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_nav_feud target = scope:oe_lgr_ath_s } }
        scope:oe_lgr_ath_s = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_nav_feud target = c:ACH } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_navarrese value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. la3 the Acciaioli in Athens (1385-1388): Nerio I becomes the ruler of ATH, ATH leaves its overlord,
# Corinth goes from Achaea to Athens (only while both are AI), Greek becomes an accepted culture.
oe_lgr_la3_do = {
    c:ATH = {
        oe_lgr_make_nerio = yes
        if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord = { cancel_subject = c:ATH } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { culture = culture:greek_culture } NOT = { has_accepted_culture = culture:greek_culture } }
            add_accepted_culture = culture:greek_culture
        }
    }
    oe_lgr_cor_to_ath = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_athens value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_nerio_rules = no } debug_log = "oe_lgr la3: Nerio could not be created or made ruler; the rest of the step ran without the character" }
}
# ATH scope. Nerio I Acciaioli, created at runtime (design 3.9; no character is added to the 1337 setup). Engine
# probe 4 (a character with a named dynasty) passed in game (r19, 2026-11-19). The guard stays: when the first
# create_character leaves no character, a second one without the dynasty line is tried (global oe_lgr_nerio_made 1 / 2).
oe_lgr_make_nerio = {
    create_character = {
        first_name = oe_lgr_name_nerio
        female = no
        age = 50
        dynasty = dynasty:acciaioli_dynasty
        culture = culture:tuscan
        religion = religion:catholic
        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
        save_scope_as = oe_lgr_nerio_s
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_nerio_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_nerio_made value = 1 } }
    else = {
        create_character = {
            first_name = oe_lgr_name_nerio
            female = no
            age = 50
            culture = culture:tuscan
            religion = religion:catholic
            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
            save_scope_as = oe_lgr_nerio_s
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_nerio_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_nerio_made value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_nerio_s }
        scope:oe_lgr_nerio_s = { set_variable = oe_lgr_is_nerio }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_lgr_nerio_s
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_nerio value = scope:oe_lgr_nerio_s }
    }
}
# Any scope. Corinth from Achaea to Athens (la3's third part; also the test button lgrcor).
oe_lgr_cor_to_ath = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_cor_movable = yes }
        location:corinth = { change_location_owner = c:ATH }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_cor_ath value = 1 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. la4 Nerio's will: only the books (design: nobody is killed, the map does not change).
oe_lgr_la4_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_will value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay / gain $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_lgr_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_lgr_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# BYZ scope. The Peloponnese (theme region 14): every place of ours and of our subjects there (as D4's oe_lat_morea_mod).
oe_lgr_morea_mod = {
    every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace } }
    every_subject = { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace } } }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 a: the price is paid and Corinth changes hands (nothing when Corinth has no other owner any more).
oe_lgr_buy_corinth = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:corinth = { exists = owner NOT = { owner = c:BYZ } } }
        location:corinth = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_seller } }
        add_gold = { value = oe_lgr_cor_price multiply = -1 }
        location:corinth = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
        scope:oe_lgr_seller = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_b_cor_sold target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_lgr.90: the heavy part of an option, by var:oe_lgr_do (1 = .1 b, 2 = .1 c, 3 = .3 a;
# later phases: 4, 11, 12, 20). No debug_log here or below it.
oe_lgr_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 1 } oe_lgr_morea_mod = { mod = oe_lgr_morea_quiet years = 5 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 2 }
        oe_lgr_morea_mod = { mod = oe_lgr_turk_guests years = 2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ACH } c:ACH = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_lgr_evrenos_raid years = 3 mode = replace } } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 3 } oe_lgr_buy_corinth = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 11 } oe_lgr_job_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 12 } oe_lgr_job_12 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 4 } oe_lgr_job_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_do ?= 20 } oe_lgr_job_20 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_do } remove_variable = oe_lgr_do }
}

# BYZ scope. Show .1: the Company enters Achaea first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot, only its result is
# recorded, for the text.
oe_lgr_test_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la2 } oe_lgr_la2_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la2_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_navarrese } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_navarrese value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la2 could not run as a world step; recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_1 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.1 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .1 cannot be shown (Achaea is gone)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .2: Nerio takes Athens first if that can run (date ignored). The event needs Nerio on the throne.
oe_lgr_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la3 } oe_lgr_la3_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la3_run = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_2 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.2 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .2 cannot be shown (Nerio must rule an AI Catholic ATH that owns Athens; run la3 first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .3: la3 and la4 run first if they can (dates ignored); when la4 cannot, the will is recorded for
# the text only. The event needs Corinth in the hands of a Catholic country at peace with us.
oe_lgr_test_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la3 } oe_lgr_la3_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la3_run = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la4 } oe_lgr_la4_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la4_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_will } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_will value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la4 could not run as a world step; the will was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_3 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.3 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .3 cannot be shown (Corinth must be held by a Catholic country that is neither our subject nor at war with us)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Only la3's third part: Corinth from Achaea to Athens.

    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: Corinth cannot move (Achaea must own and control it; Achaea and ATH both AI and not at war with each other)" }
}

# Country scope. A western state built or woken by this line gets, in this order and before its ruler (brief: the
# ruler's title is wrong when the government is set after the ruler), a monarchy, the Greek culture, the Orthodox
# faith and the Greek court language. Each only where it differs.
oe_lgr_west_state = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy } } change_government_type = government_type:monarchy }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { culture = culture:greek_culture } } change_culture = culture:greek_culture }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = religion:orthodox } } change_religion = religion:orthodox }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { court_language ?= { this = language:greek_language } } } set_court_language = culture:greek_culture.dialect }
}

# BYZ scope. ep0 Dušan goes south (1347-1348; only an AI empire, design item 3): Serbia takes our places in theme
# regions 11 (Nikopolis) and 12 (Thessaly), as the 1341 war's oe_cw_serbia_take_one does; an AI Epirus that is still
# our subject is annexed by Serbia. Nikephoros, if still in Epirus, goes to the empire first: in history the empire had
# taken him in 1340, and a ruler of an annexed country may die with it (death reason country_annexed).
oe_lgr_ep0_do = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_nik_alive = yes country_exists = c:EPI character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini = { owner ?= c:EPI } }
        character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini = { move_country = c:BYZ }
    }
    every_owned_location = { limit = { oe_lgr_ep0_loc = yes } change_location_owner = c:SER }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:EPI c:EPI = { is_ai = yes overlord ?= { tag = BYZ } } }
        c:SER = { annex_country = { country = c:EPI reason = MilitaryConquest transfer = yes } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_dusan_south value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. ep1 the Tocco in the isles (1357; Leukas and Vonitsa about 1362): Leonardo I Tocco rules Cephalonia; the
# two places of an AI Argos at peace with Cephalonia go to it.
oe_lgr_ep1_do = {
    c:CEP = { oe_lgr_make_tocco = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ARG c:ARG = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:CEP } } }
        location:leukas = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:ARG controller ?= c:ARG has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:CEP } }
        location:vonitsa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:ARG controller ?= c:ARG has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:CEP } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_tocco value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. ep2 Thessaly's emperor (1356-1359): an AI Serbia hands THS its Thessalian places (decision 230), Trikala
# first. Self-check: THS with at least two locations (oe_lgr_ths 1), else 5 (it exists with fewer) or 4 (nothing).
# Then THS gets its state (oe_lgr_west_state), Trikala as capital, the marks for its titles (oe_lgr_ths_emperor;
# oe_name_full_title: the long name is "Thessaly" alone), Simeon Uroš as ruler, a truce of 5 years with Serbia, and the
# two emperors' ill will.
oe_lgr_ep2_do = {
    location:trikala = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:demetrias = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:elassona = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:farsala = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:karditsa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:larissa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:stomio = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:loidoriki = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:neopatras = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:tyrnavos = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:THS } } add_core = c:THS } }
    location:trikala = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:demetrias = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:elassona = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:farsala = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:karditsa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:larissa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:stomio = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:loidoriki = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:neopatras = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    location:tyrnavos = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:THS } change_location_owner = c:THS } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_ths_two = yes }
        c:THS = {
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord ?= { cancel_subject = c:THS } }
            oe_lgr_west_state = yes
            if = { limit = { location:trikala = { owner ?= c:THS is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:trikala }
            set_variable = oe_lgr_ths_emperor
            set_variable = oe_name_full_title
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = character:ser_simeon_uros character:ser_simeon_uros = { is_alive = yes } }
            character:ser_simeon_uros = { move_country = c:THS }
            if = { limit = { character:ser_simeon_uros = { owner ?= c:THS } } c:THS = { set_new_ruler = character:ser_simeon_uros } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:SER }
            if = { limit = { c:SER = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:THS } } } c:THS = { add_truce_with = { target = c:SER years = 5 mutual = yes } } }
            c:SER = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_two_emperors target = c:THS } }
            c:THS = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_two_emperors target = c:SER } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ths value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:THS } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ths value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ths value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope. ep3 Nikephoros restored (1356-1357): the AI owner X of Arta hands EPI its Epirote places, Arta first
# (decision 230). Self-check: EPI with at least two locations (oe_lgr_epi 1), else 5 or 4. Then EPI gets its state,
# Arta as capital, no overlord, a truce of 5 years with X, and Nikephoros as ruler. Also from .90 (.11 a / b).
oe_lgr_ep3_do = {
    location:arta = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ep3_x } }
    location:arta = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:angelokastron = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:preveza = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:parga = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:kleisoura_epirus = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:argyrokastro = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:karpenisi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:konitsa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:EPI } } add_core = c:EPI } }
    location:arta = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:angelokastron = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:preveza = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:parga = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:kleisoura_epirus = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:argyrokastro = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:karpenisi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    location:konitsa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:EPI } change_location_owner = c:EPI } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_epi_two = yes }
        c:EPI = {
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord ?= { cancel_subject = c:EPI } }
            oe_lgr_west_state = yes
            if = { limit = { location:arta = { owner ?= c:EPI is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:arta }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x } } add_truce_with = { target = scope:oe_lgr_ep3_x years = 5 mutual = yes } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_lgr_nik_alive = yes }
            character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini = { move_country = c:EPI }
            if = { limit = { character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini = { owner ?= c:EPI } } c:EPI = { set_new_ruler = character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_epi value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:EPI } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_epi value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_epi value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope. ep4 the Achelous (1358-1359): Nikephoros falls in battle against the Albanians (70%; 50%
# after .11 b). Peter Losha is made ruler first, then Nikephoros dies (the order the Golden Horde line uses); an
# Epirus that was our subject leaves the empire; Thessaly, if there, and Epirus like each other (Simeon recognised the
# new despot). Else Epirus gains prestige.
oe_lgr_ep4_do = {
    random = {
        chance = oe_lgr_nik_death
        c:EPI = { oe_lgr_make_losha = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_lgr_nik_alive = yes } kill_character = { target = character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini reason = battle location = location:angelokastron } }
        if = { limit = { c:EPI = { overlord ?= { tag = BYZ } } } cancel_subject = c:EPI }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:THS }
            c:THS = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_despot_recognised target = c:EPI } }
            c:EPI = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_despot_recognised target = c:THS } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_achelous value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_arta value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_achelous } }
        c:EPI = { add_prestige = 10 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_achelous value = 2 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. ep5 the despot of Ioannina (1366-1367): a dynamic country from Ioannina in the form engine probe 7 used
# (seen in r20: the country exists, owns the place, has a ruler), named Ioannina, ruled by Thomas Preljubović; the
# vassal of an independent AI Thessaly; a truce of 5 years with the old owner X; ill will with Epirus. It takes no title
# here: the despot line's oe_dsp.2 grants it (oe_dsp_ioa_ok). Record oe_lgr_ioa_st 1 built, 4 nothing.
oe_lgr_ep5_do = {
    location:ioannina = {
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ioa_x }
        if = {
        	limit = { has_owner = yes }
	        create_country_from_location = {
	            save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ioa_new
	            change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
	            change_country_type = location
	            change_religion = religion:orthodox
	            change_culture = culture:greek_culture
	        }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_new location:ioannina = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ioa_new } }
        scope:oe_lgr_ioa_new = {
            set_variable = oe_lgr_ioannina
            change_country_name = oe_lgr_ioannina_name
            change_country_adjective = oe_lgr_ioannina_adj
            oe_lgr_west_state = yes
            oe_lgr_make_thomas = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_x } } add_truce_with = { target = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_x years = 5 mutual = yes } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ths OR = { global_var:oe_lgr_ths = 1 global_var:oe_lgr_ths = 2 }
                    country_exists = c:THS c:THS = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_new } }
                }
                make_subject_of = { target = c:THS type = subject_type:vassal }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:EPI }
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_ioannina_arta target = c:EPI }
                c:EPI = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_ioannina_arta target = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_new } }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ioa value = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_new }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ioa_st value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ioa_st value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope. ep6 Thessaly's caesar (1372-1374): Alexios Angelos Philanthropenos rules Thessaly; the emperor's mark goes
# (the title hook then shows a caesar).
oe_lgr_ep6_do = {
    c:THS = {
        oe_lgr_make_alexios = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_ths_emperor } remove_variable = oe_lgr_ths_emperor }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ths value = 2 }
}

# BYZ scope. ep7 Arta changes masters (1374, Peter Losha dies of the plague): Gjin Bua Spata rules Epirus.
oe_lgr_ep7_do = {
    c:EPI = { oe_lgr_make_spata = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_arta value = 2 }
}

# Country scope (the country the character will rule). Leonardo I Tocco (ep1; design 3.9), created at
# runtime and made ruler; global oe_lgr_tocco_made 1 with the dynasty, 2 without; oe_lgr_c_tocco the character.
oe_lgr_make_tocco = {
    create_character = {
        first_name = name_leonard
        female = no
        age = 40
        dynasty = dynasty:oe_lgr_tocco_dynasty
        culture = culture:neapolitan
        religion = religion:catholic
        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
        save_scope_as = oe_lgr_tocco_s
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_tocco_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_tocco_made value = 1 } }
    else = {
        create_character = {
            first_name = name_leonard
            female = no
            age = 40
            culture = culture:neapolitan
            religion = religion:catholic
            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
            save_scope_as = oe_lgr_tocco_s
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_tocco_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_tocco_made value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_tocco_s }
        scope:oe_lgr_tocco_s = { set_variable = oe_lgr_is_tocco }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_lgr_tocco_s
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_c_tocco value = scope:oe_lgr_tocco_s }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .90 code 11 (.11 a / b): ep3 at once, when it still can be done; Epirus likes us; after b it becomes our
# Roman client. No debug_log here or below.
oe_lgr_job_11 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep3 } oe_lgr_ep3_core = yes }
        oe_lgr_ep3_do = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_ep3 value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_epi global_var:oe_lgr_epi = 1 country_exists = c:EPI }
            c:EPI = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_b_nik_freed target = c:BYZ } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_lgr_nik ?= 2 c:EPI = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no } }
                c:EPI = { make_subject_of = { target = c:BYZ type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub } }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ws_ep3 value = 2 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .90 code 12 (.12 a): the dignity of caesar through the despot line (C2: oe_dsp_confer, target var:oe_dsp_t
# set by .12 itself), only while the slot still holds Thessaly; then the slot is freed.
oe_lgr_job_12 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_dsp_t_mine var:oe_dsp_t ?= { tag = THS } } oe_dsp_confer = { t = kaisar } }
    oe_lgr_drop_dsp_t = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Frees C2's target slot if .12 filled it.
oe_lgr_drop_dsp_t = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_lgr_dsp_t_mine }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
        remove_variable = oe_lgr_dsp_t_mine
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Run a world step of phase 2 now: the date is ignored, the AI and the preconditions are still checked.
oe_lgr_test_ep0 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep0 } debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep0 is already recorded (ws2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws2a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws2b')|0] west [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_west')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ep0_ok = yes } oe_lgr_ep0_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep0 cannot run now (the empire must be AI; Dušan must rule an AI Serbia at peace with us; we must hold places in theme regions 11 or 12)" }
}

oe_lgr_test_ep7 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep7 } debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep7 is already recorded (ws2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws2a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws2b')|0] west [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_west')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ep7_ok = yes } oe_lgr_ep7_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep7 cannot run now (an AI Epirus ruled by a Losha)" }
}
# BYZ scope. ep0 for a test as the empire's player: Serbia takes our places in regions 11 and 12 although we are not AI
# (Dušan need not rule; Serbia must exist, be AI and at peace with us).
oe_lgr_test_ep0f = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep0 } country_exists = c:SER c:SER = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } }
        oe_lgr_ep0_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep0 (forced) cannot run (Serbia must be AI and at peace with us; ep0 not recorded yet)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .11: Nikephoros is brought to our court first if alive elsewhere (test only). The event needs Arta in
# the hands of an AI Serbia or Thessaly and no Epirus (run lgr2ep0f first in a 1337 game).
oe_lgr_test_11 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_nik_alive = yes oe_lgr_nik_home = no } character:epi_nikephoros_ii_orsini = { move_country = c:BYZ } }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_11 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.11 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .11 cannot be shown (Nikephoros alive at our court; Arta held by an AI Serbia or Thessaly; no Epirus; ep3 not recorded)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .12: ep2 and ep6 run first if they can (dates ignored). The event needs an independent AI Thessaly
# with its caesar (oe_lgr_ths 2).
oe_lgr_test_12 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep2 } oe_lgr_ep2_ok = yes } oe_lgr_ep2_run = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep6 } oe_lgr_ep6_ok = yes } oe_lgr_ep6_run = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_12 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.12 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .12 cannot be shown (an independent AI Thessaly at peace with us whose caesar came with ep6)" }
}

# BYZ scope. ep8 Ioannina's Florentine (1385; the homage to the sultan 1386): Esau Buondelmonti rules Ioannina (the
# dynamic country of ep5, read through the global oe_lgr_ioa); the Ottomans like it. Thomas is not killed (as ep7 does
# not kill Losha). oe_lgr_ioa_st 2.
oe_lgr_ep8_do = {
    global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ioa_s }
    scope:oe_lgr_ioa_s = { oe_lgr_make_esau = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_homage target = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_s } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ioa_st value = 2 }
}

# Any scope. The one place where phase 3 takes a whole country in peace (ep9, ep11, ep12): scope:oe_lgr_taker takes
# scope:oe_lgr_taken. Form "annex" (generator switch ANNEX_FORM; "annex" = annex_country, reason Diplomatic, transfer,
# seen in game only during a war; "land" = every place handed over, the capital last). Each caller then checks the result.
oe_lgr_annex = {
    scope:oe_lgr_taker = { annex_country = { country = scope:oe_lgr_taken reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
}

# BYZ scope. ep9 Thessaly falls (1393-1394): the Ottomans take Thessaly whole. Ioannina, if Thessaly's vassal (ep5), is
# let go first: what a taken country's subjects become is not known.
oe_lgr_ep9_do = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_ioa_alive = yes global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { overlord ?= { tag = THS } } }
        global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ioa_s }
        c:THS = { cancel_subject = scope:oe_lgr_ioa_s }
    }
    c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_taker }
    c:THS = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_taken }
    oe_lgr_annex = yes
    oe_lgr_check_ep9 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. ep10 Salona opens its gates (1393-1394): Loidoriki and Salona, Salona's capital, go to the Ottomans
# (design: Salona is not annexed; it keeps Karystos and Malta, and the engine picks a new capital); Zetounion and
# Neopatras of an AI Neopatras at peace with the Ottomans too, Neopatras (its capital) only when Neopatras holds
# nothing else (then the duchy is gone, and Salona its vassal with it loses its overlord).
oe_lgr_ep10_do = {
    location:loidoriki = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SAO controller ?= c:SAO has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:salona = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SAO controller ?= c:SAO has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:NEO c:NEO = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } }
        location:zetounion = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:NEO controller ?= c:NEO has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
        if = {
            limit = { c:NEO = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { NOT = { OR = { this = location:neopatras this = location:zetounion } } } } } }
            location:neopatras = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:NEO controller ?= c:NEO has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
        }
    }
    oe_lgr_check_ep10 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. ep11 the Tocco in Ioannina (1411): a Cephalonia of the Tocco takes Ioannina whole. Cephalonia first leaves
# an AI Achaea (design); Ioannina first leaves an AI overlord other than Cephalonia. oe_lgr_ioa_st 3 once checked.
oe_lgr_ep11_do = {
    global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_taken }
    c:CEP = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_taker }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ACH c:CEP = { overlord ?= { tag = ACH is_ai = yes } } } c:ACH = { cancel_subject = c:CEP } }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_lgr_taken = { is_subject = yes NOT = { overlord ?= { tag = CEP } } } }
        scope:oe_lgr_taken = { overlord = { cancel_subject = scope:oe_lgr_taken } }
    }
    oe_lgr_annex = yes
    oe_lgr_check_ep11 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. ep12 Arta opens its gates (1416): the Tocco Cephalonia takes Epirus whole; Epirus first leaves an AI
# overlord other than Cephalonia. oe_lgr_arta 3 once checked.
oe_lgr_ep12_do = {
    c:EPI = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_taken }
    c:CEP = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_taker }
    if = {
        limit = { c:EPI = { is_subject = yes NOT = { overlord ?= { tag = CEP } } } }
        c:EPI = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:EPI } }
    }
    oe_lgr_annex = yes
    oe_lgr_check_ep12 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. ep13 Ioannina opens its gates (1430): the owner X of Ioannina gives the sultan its places in northern
# Epirus (never its capital) and Ioannina (its capital only when X holds nothing else: oe_lgr_ott_take_ioannina, then X
# is gone). oe_lgr_ioa_st 6 once checked.
oe_lgr_ep13_do = {
    location:ioannina = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ott_x } }
    location:avlonya = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:argyrokastro = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:butrint = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:kleisoura_epirus = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:konitsa = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:ioannina = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    oe_lgr_check_ep13 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. ep14 Arta falls (1449): the owner X of Arta gives the sultan Preveza (never its capital) and Arta (its
# capital only when X holds nothing else: oe_lgr_ott_take_arta). oe_lgr_arta 4 once checked.
oe_lgr_ep14_do = {
    location:arta = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ott_x } }
    location:preveza = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:arta = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x controller ?= scope:oe_lgr_ott_x has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    oe_lgr_check_ep14 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. The self-check of each step that takes a country or moves land: the result is there (1, and what the
# step records), not yet seen (9: oe_lgr_world looks again next month), still not there a month later (5). Nothing in
# this line depends on a step whose result is not there.
oe_lgr_check_ep9 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ep9 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_thessaly_fell value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep9 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep9 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep9 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep9 value = 9 } }
}
oe_lgr_check_ep10 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ep10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_salona_fell value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep10 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep10 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep10 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep10 value = 9 } }
}
oe_lgr_check_ep11 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ep11 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ioa_st value = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep11 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep11 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep11 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep11 value = 9 } }
}
oe_lgr_check_ep12 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ep12 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_arta value = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep12 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep12 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep12 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep12 value = 9 } }
}
oe_lgr_check_ep13 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ep13 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ioa_st value = 6 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep13 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep13 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep13 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep13 value = 9 } }
}
oe_lgr_check_ep14 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ep14 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_arta value = 4 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ep14 value = 9 } }
}

# Country scope (Ioannina). Esau Buondelmonti (ep8; design 3.9), created at runtime and made ruler; global
# oe_lgr_esau_made 1 with the house of Buondelmonti, 2 without; oe_lgr_c_esau the character.
oe_lgr_make_esau = {
    create_character = {
        first_name = oe_lgr_name_esau
        female = no
        age = 35
        dynasty = dynasty:oe_lgr_buondelmonti_dynasty
        culture = culture:tuscan
        religion = religion:orthodox
        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
        save_scope_as = oe_lgr_esau_s
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_esau_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_esau_made value = 1 } }
    else = {
        create_character = {
            first_name = oe_lgr_name_esau
            female = no
            age = 35
            culture = culture:tuscan
            religion = religion:orthodox
            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
            save_scope_as = oe_lgr_esau_s
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_esau_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_esau_made value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_esau_s }
        scope:oe_lgr_esau_s = { set_variable = oe_lgr_is_esau }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_lgr_esau_s
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_c_esau value = scope:oe_lgr_esau_s }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts of phase 3.
oe_lgr_log3 = { debug_log = "oe_lgr p3 m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_m')|0] ws3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws3a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws3b')|0] chk=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk3a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk3b')|0] fall=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_fall')|0] esau=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_esau')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_st13')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_st14')|0] sal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_sal')|0] exl=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_exl')|0] tie=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_tie')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_last')|0]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES, prefix lg3)
# BYZ scope. Run a world step of phase 3 now: the date is ignored, the AI and the preconditions are still checked.
oe_lgr_test_ep8 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }

    else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ep8_ok = yes } oe_lgr_ep8_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep8 cannot run now (Ioannina (ep5) must exist, AI, ruled by a Preljubović)" }
}

# BYZ scope. ep13 for a test: Ioannina goes to the Ottomans from any AI owner other than them, where it is not that
# owner's capital (the border and the peace are not asked; in a 1337 game run lgr2ep0f first).
oe_lgr_test_ep13f = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep13 } country_exists = c:TUR location:ioannina = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = TUR } } is_capital = no } }
        oe_lgr_ep13_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: ep13 (forced) cannot run (an AI other than the Ottomans must hold Ioannina, not as its capital; ep13 not recorded yet)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .13: it needs an AI Salona that holds Salona (dates and the Ottomans' nearness ignored).
oe_lgr_test_13 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_13 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.13 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .13 cannot be shown (an AI Salona must hold Salona)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .14: ep13 runs first if it can (date ignored). The event needs Ioannina in the sultan's hands.
oe_lgr_test_14 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep13 } oe_lgr_ep13_ok = yes } oe_lgr_ep13_run = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_14 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_14 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.14 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .14 cannot be shown (the Ottomans must hold Ioannina; try lg3ep13f first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget phase 3's state and records (what the steps changed in the world stays; oe_lgr_ioa_st and
# oe_lgr_arta, shared with phase 2, stay too).
oe_lgr_test_reset3 = {
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_st_13
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_st_14
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_salona
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_exiles
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_tocco_tie
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_ioa_m
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_p3
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_p3_new
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep8
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep9
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep10
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep11
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep12
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep13
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep14
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep9
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep10
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep11
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep12
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep13
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ep14
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_thessaly_fell
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_salona_fell
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_esau_made
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_c_esau
}

# BYZ scope. la5 the Crispo in Naxos (1383): Francesco Crispo rules Naxos; Naxos leans on Venice. Read back: the ruler
# carries the mark make_char set (oe_lgr_naxos 1), else 4.
oe_lgr_la5_do = {
    c:NAX = { oe_lgr_make_crispo = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:NAX = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_bw_crispo target = c:VEN } } }
    if = { limit = { c:NAX = { exists = ruler ruler = { has_variable = oe_lgr_is_crispo } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_naxos value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_naxos value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope. la6 Negroponte to Venice (1390; design: a vassal, not annexed): checked at once and a month later.
oe_lgr_la6_do = {
    c:NEG = { make_subject_of = { target = c:VEN type = subject_type:vassal } }
    oe_lgr_check_la6 = yes
}

# BYZ scope. la7 Achaea's new prince (1396, the title bought from Ladislaus): Pedro de San Superano rules Achaea
# (oe_lgr_achaea 1), else 4.
oe_lgr_la7_do = {
    c:ACH = { oe_lgr_make_pedro = yes }
    if = { limit = { c:ACH = { exists = ruler ruler = { has_variable = oe_lgr_is_pedro } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_achaea value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_achaea value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope. la8 Zaccaria buys the title (1404): Centurione II Zaccaria rules Achaea (oe_lgr_achaea 2, else 5); the
# Company's rule (oe_lgr_navarrese_rule, la2) is over.
oe_lgr_la8_do = {
    c:ACH = {
        oe_lgr_make_centurione = yes
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_lgr_navarrese_rule } remove_country_modifier = oe_lgr_navarrese_rule }
    }
    if = { limit = { c:ACH = { exists = ruler ruler = { has_variable = oe_lgr_is_centurione } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_achaea value = 2 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_achaea value = 5 } }
}

# Country scope (the country the character will rule). Francesco Crispo (la5; design 3.9), created at
# runtime and made ruler; global oe_lgr_crispo_made 1 with the house, 2 without; oe_lgr_c_crispo the character.
oe_lgr_make_crispo = {
    create_character = {
        first_name = name_francis
        female = no
        age = 40
        dynasty = dynasty:oe_lgr_crispo_dynasty
        culture = culture:lombard
        religion = religion:catholic
        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
        save_scope_as = oe_lgr_crispo_s
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_crispo_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_crispo_made value = 1 } }
    else = {
        create_character = {
            first_name = name_francis
            female = no
            age = 40
            culture = culture:lombard
            religion = religion:catholic
            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
            save_scope_as = oe_lgr_crispo_s
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_crispo_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_crispo_made value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_crispo_s }
        scope:oe_lgr_crispo_s = { set_variable = oe_lgr_is_crispo }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_lgr_crispo_s
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_c_crispo value = scope:oe_lgr_crispo_s }
    }
}
# Country scope (the country the character will rule). Pedro de San Superano (la7; design 3.9), created at
# runtime and made ruler; global oe_lgr_pedro_made 1 (no house); oe_lgr_c_pedro the character.
oe_lgr_make_pedro = {
    create_character = {
        first_name = oe_lgr_name_pedro
        female = no
        age = 45
        culture = culture:gascon
        religion = religion:catholic
        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
        save_scope_as = oe_lgr_pedro_s
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_pedro_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_pedro_made value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_pedro_s }
        scope:oe_lgr_pedro_s = { set_variable = oe_lgr_is_pedro }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_lgr_pedro_s
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_c_pedro value = scope:oe_lgr_pedro_s }
    }
}
# Country scope (the country the character will rule). Centurione II Zaccaria (la8; design 3.9), created at
# runtime and made ruler; global oe_lgr_centurione_made 1 with the house, 2 without; oe_lgr_c_centurione the character.
oe_lgr_make_centurione = {
    create_character = {
        first_name = oe_lgr_name_centurione
        female = no
        age = 35
        dynasty = dynasty:zaccaria_dynasty
        culture = culture:ligurian
        religion = religion:catholic
        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
        save_scope_as = oe_lgr_centurione_s
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_centurione_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_centurione_made value = 1 } }
    else = {
        create_character = {
            first_name = oe_lgr_name_centurione
            female = no
            age = 35
            culture = culture:ligurian
            religion = religion:catholic
            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
            save_scope_as = oe_lgr_centurione_s
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_centurione_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_centurione_made value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_centurione_s }
        scope:oe_lgr_centurione_s = { set_variable = oe_lgr_is_centurione }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_lgr_centurione_s
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_c_centurione value = scope:oe_lgr_centurione_s }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .90 code 4 (.4 b): a place of Achaea that borders the empire, not its capital, passes to the empire
# (BYZ oe_lgr_vicar_land 1 when it is ours afterwards, 9 when not). No debug_log here or below.
oe_lgr_job_4 = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ACH c:ACH = { any_owned_location = { oe_lgr_ach_swap = yes } } }
        c:ACH = { random_owned_location = { limit = { oe_lgr_ach_swap = yes } save_scope_as = oe_lgr_swap_loc } }
        scope:oe_lgr_swap_loc ?= { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lgr_swap_loc scope:oe_lgr_swap_loc = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_vicar_land value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_vicar_land value = 9 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .90 code 20 (.20 a): the lord of Athens (still AI, at peace with us) leaves an AI overlord and becomes
# our Roman client; checked at once and a month later (oe_lgr_athens_client 1). A D4 oe_lat.12 that has already come
# is marked so that it does not undo the tie (oe_lgr_hex_old). Athens with no Latin lord any more: 4.
oe_lgr_job_20 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_lgr_has_ath = yes location:athens = { owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } } }
        location:athens = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ath_s20 } }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_lgr_ath_s20 = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = BYZ } } } }
            scope:oe_lgr_ath_s20 = { overlord = { cancel_subject = scope:oe_lgr_ath_s20 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_lgr_ath_s20 = { is_subject = no } }
            scope:oe_lgr_ath_s20 = { make_subject_of = { target = c:BYZ type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub } }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } set_variable = oe_lgr_hex_old }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_ath_client_c value = scope:oe_lgr_ath_s20 }
        oe_lgr_check_ath20 = yes
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_athens_client value = 4 } }
}
# BYZ scope. The tie with Athens is undone (D4's oe_lat.12 ended in failure; also the test button lg4rel).
oe_lgr_release_ath = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ath_client_c country_exists = global_var:oe_lgr_ath_client_c global_var:oe_lgr_ath_client_c = { is_ai = yes overlord ?= { tag = BYZ } } }
        global_var:oe_lgr_ath_client_c = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_rel }
        cancel_subject = scope:oe_lgr_rel
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_athens_client value = 2 }
}

# The self-checks of phase 4 (as phase 3's): 1 the result is there, 9 not yet seen, 5 still not there a month later.
oe_lgr_check_la6 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_la6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_negroponte value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_la6 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_la6 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_la6 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_la6 value = 9 } }
}
oe_lgr_check_ath20 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_done_ath20 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_athens_client value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ath20 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ath20 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ath20 value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_chk_ath20 value = 9 } }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts of phase 4.
oe_lgr_log4 = { debug_log = "oe_lgr p4 m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_m')|0] ws4=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0] made4=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_made4')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_st4')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_st20')|0] vicar=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_vic')|0] land=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_vland')|0] achtie=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_achtie')|0] thebes=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_th20')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_v_last')|0]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES, prefix lg4)
# BYZ scope. Run a world step of phase 4 now: the date is ignored, the AI and the preconditions are still checked.
oe_lgr_test_la5 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la5 } debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la5 is already recorded (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_la5_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la5_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la5 cannot run now (Naxos must be AI with a ruler who is no Crispo)" }
}
oe_lgr_test_la6 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la6 } debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la6 is already recorded (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lgr_la6_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la6_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la6 cannot run now (Negroponte independent, AI, outside the imperial bloc, at peace with an AI Venice)" }
}

    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7 } debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la7 is already recorded (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0]); reset first" }

}
oe_lgr_test_la8 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8 } debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la8 is already recorded (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0]); reset first" }

    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la8 cannot run now (la7 must have made Pedro prince (lg4la7 first); Achaea AI, its ruler no Zaccaria)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .4: the Company enters Achaea first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot, only its result is
# recorded, for the text.
oe_lgr_test_4 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la2 } oe_lgr_la2_ok = yes } oe_lgr_la2_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_navarrese } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lgr_navarrese value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_lgr test: la2 could not run as a world step; recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_4 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.4 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .4 cannot be shown (Achaea must exist, AI, at peace with us)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .20: it needs a Latin lord of Athens (Corinth and the despotate are not asked here).
oe_lgr_test_20 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_lgr_ev_20 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_st_20 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.20 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: .20 cannot be shown (Athens must be held by an AI Catholic ATH, or an Argos that took Athens)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Undo .20 a's tie with Athens as if the Hexamilion had been lost.
oe_lgr_test_rel = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_athens_client global_var:oe_lgr_athens_client = 1 } oe_lgr_release_ath = yes debug_log = "oe_lgr test: the tie with Athens undone (ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_ws4')|0] chk4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_chk4')|0] late [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lgr_rd_late')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lgr test: no tie with Athens to undo (lg4e20 first, option a)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget phase 4's state and records (what the steps changed in the world stays).
oe_lgr_test_reset4 = {
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_st_4
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_st_20
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_vicar
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_vicar_land
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_ach_tie
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_thebes20
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_hex_seen
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_hex_old
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_p4
    remove_variable = oe_lgr_p4_new
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la5
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la6
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la7
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_la8
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_la6
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_chk_ath20
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_naxos
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_negroponte
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_achaea
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_athens_client
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_ath_client_c
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_crispo_made
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_pedro_made
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_centurione_made
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_c_crispo
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_c_pedro
    remove_global_variable = oe_lgr_c_centurione
}
